feeds.what: version pointer for the 2026-11-03 Statewide General Election
feeds.notes: Body was 386661. Cache-Control: no-cache. Clarity ENR on the state's own host (www.enr-scvotes.org) instead of results.enr.clarityelections.com; path layout is the same.

feeds.what: every contest of the election in one document (171 contests)
feeds.notes: …/SC/<election id>/<version from current_ver.txt>/json/en/summary.json. Cache-Control: max-age=86400 on the versioned file (the version changes instead). Includes three 'STRAIGHT PARTY n' pseudo-contests that must be filtered out.

feeds.what: election settings: date, last update time, precincts reporting, per-county election ids and versions, winners
feeds.notes: settings.electiondetails.participatingcounties lists each county as 'Name|county election id|version|last update|n' (e.g. 'Abbeville|127301|385871|11/6/2026 10:52:28 AM EST|16'), which gives the county-level Clarity sites.

feeds.what: the separate 'Statewide General Election Recount' election (3 contests, in progress on 2026-11-10): pointer, summary, settings
feeds.notes: Recounts are published as a different Clarity election id (127592), not as an update of 127300. Also saved: recount-127592-current_ver.txt (386677) and recount-127592-electionsettings.json. Two of its three contests still showed zero votes.

election_id: 127300, the path segment after /SC/. The current version (386661 when fetched) follows it. The recount is a separate id, 127592.
discovery: No elections-list endpoint found. The ids are linked by hand from https://scvotes.gov/elections-statistics/election-results/ (anchor text 'Statewide General Election' -> https://www.enr-scvotes.org/SC/127300/web.345435/#/summary). Within an election, current_ver.txt gives the version.
bot_blocking: None. Relay User-Agent got 200 on everything (CloudFront, no challenge). Browser User-Agent not needed, not tried.
updated_field: electionsettings.json top-level "websiteupdatedat":"11/10/2026 5:20:41 PM EST" (US Eastern, zone abbreviation in the string). Per county in participatingcounties. summary.json has no timestamp.
reporting_field: electionsettings.json top level: "stateprecinctsreporting":2312, "stateprecinctsparticipating":2312, "stateprecinctspartiallyreporting":0. In summary.json, TP is the number of COUNTIES in the contest (Governor TP 46) and PR was 0 on every contest, so per-contest precincts reporting is not usable from the summary.
choice_format: Party abbreviation is prefixed to the name, and also given in the parallel P array: CH "REP Alan Wilson / Mike Reichenbach", P "REP", V 1051334 (governor is a joint ticket with ' / '). Write-ins are "Write-In" with P "NON". Nonpartisan local candidates have no prefix and P "NON". Local referenda: "Yes, In Favor of the Question" / "No, Opposed to the Question" (capitalisation varies: 'In favor' on one contest).
district_field: Only in the title, and with DOUBLE spaces: "U.S.  House of Representatives, District  1", "State  House of Representatives, District  1". No separate district field (K is the contest key).
terms: none found (not searched beyond the results site and the scvotes.gov results page).
